correctness.rationale: For odd moved support m>=3, the derangement recurrence and parity give v2(D_m)=v2(m-1). The factorial quotient binom(n,m)(m-1)=n(n-1)(n-2) binom(n-3,m-3)/(m(m-2)) makes the claimed full two-adic spectrum exact, and m=3 reaches the minimum for n>=4. For an odd p not powering n, a nonzero higher base-p digit gives a proper odd moved support m=p^j with both binom(n,m) and D_m p-units; when n=p^a every interior binomial is divisible by p, and m=p^(a-1) or m=3 has valuation exactly one. Lucas modulo two gives all digit-subset minimizers and their exact counts. The checker independently passed 17648 exact assertions, but infinite validity rests on these arguments. Boundaries n=4 and pure odd prime rows are addressed.

value.rationale: Rencontres numbers encode fixed-point statistics of permutations; isolating the parity of moved support and positive fixed-point count is a canonical combinatorial subrow. Its exact all-index content is a natural arithmetic invariant; the result determines its entire prime support and exponents, all two-adic entry values and the exact number and location of minimizers. The unbounded binary exponent together with isolated odd prime-power exceptions and digit-subset strata constitute structural classification, not an arbitrary slice or finite table.
